book: Electa Plautina (1617) by Joh. Philippus Pareus: a single work, a thesaurus of antiquarian notes on Plautus. Front matter (dedication, commendatory letters, judgments of learned men) comes first, then the alphabetical body of unnumbered Latin subject Titles, each with its Plautine citations, then the index, errata and notes. The Titles are not numbered on the sheet, so the count below is of the Titles listed here, not of a printed total.
